Vik selected W1.8.4.4.10.2.1 with "Good let's do it" after the measurement reframe. W1.8.4.4.10.2.1 is complete with a concrete eight-episode design: Anvil creation-evidence UI/API work and Loci exact .direnv exclusion/incremental-index work, two repetitions per type, fixed graph-on/off throughout three context-preserving turns. Terminal correctness, retained failures/rework and whole-episode time/normalized cost define the pilot; historical gates remain unchanged. No measured episodes or product implementation ran. Next W1.8.4.4.10.2.2 must implement matched control, multi-turn/source-version accounting, dependencies and independent oracles; final acceptance remains .10.3.

The protocol and exact prompts/schedule are in /Users/brummerv/loci/benchmarks/complete-work/design-v1/. Anvil uses the retained 638-file map from source commit53bf29e60cece2335aa39fe301935a07e8e8d4e4; every retained file hash verifies. Loci targets clean commitf3d9134aece5156bec1dcc302d4330522d1d96e5, with the serving navigation implementation pinned outside writable target source. Case-grounding Terra/high workers proposed the two realistic maintenance episodes; Sol/high method advice was reviewed by the primary. No candidate implementation, test execution, services or dependency installation occurred.

Each episode uses one fresh Terra/high fork-none native agent across orientation, implementation and related continuation. Graph-on/off is fixed throughout and not agent-selected. Eight episodes form four matched pairs with order counterbalanced per type, one measured episode at a time, stage caps120/360/240 seconds and maximum96 minutes total measured execution. Same-context continuations receive only the next fixed prompt; no outcome-based hints/replacements. Exact oracles and runner inputs must still be implemented and frozen before launch.

Primary success is terminal requested behavior with preserved invariants and supported final claims. Corrected early errors count as observed errors/rework but do not erase a correct final result; read-only/protocol violations remain unsuccessful. Independent inaccessible behavioral fixtures and blinded source review, not agent-written tests alone, determine success. Every scheduled failure stays in time/token numerators; missing telemetry is unknown, not zero.

The prospective pilot rule is zero-tolerance observed Pareto dominance across correctness by task type, severe failures, elapsed per correct completion and normalized cost per correct completion. Cost is U+alpha*K+beta*O over declared sensitivity alpha[0,1],beta[1,10], with break-even reporting; the region is analytical, not verified tariffs or billed dollars. Actual price evidence is unavailable in the observed usage surface. Mixed/inconclusive and unproven are valid outcomes; tiny differences are not claimed material or statistically established. Old1.25 binding gates and results are not retroactively changed.

The whole-workflow treatment estimates downstream-inclusive workflow effects, not the causal contribution/reuse of the initial packet or internal model reliance. Two task types/four pairs do not establish general language/workload value. Matched source/model/instructions/discovery and fixed cache/order policy remain necessary.

Source retrieval showed current capture is turn-scoped and validates sources by rereading final files. Next accounting work needs explicit per-turn episode links, no cumulative-usage double counting, and source versions at retrieval time after edits. The Anvil target lacks installed node_modules/original Git history; pinned dependencies and temporary Git/loopback fixtures are future preparation, not claimed working checks.

Manifest readback verifies .10.2.1 completion,49/54 leaves complete, .10.2.4 schedule decomposition recorded but no delivery completion, and .10.2.2 next. Design JSON/prompts/schedule/source-identity checks pass. The Objective remains Implementation and final acceptance .10.3 remains dependent on the unperformed analysis.

## How We Use It

Use Loci when codebase navigation matters. Treat its current MCP read surface as
the freshness boundary for indexed repository context. A SessionStart hook can
report an existing cache or seed an uncached repository, but that startup state
is not proof that cached content is current.

Treat MCP storage as a client-registration and process boundary, not a tool-call
choice. Each host supplies one explicit absolute store root and namespace; the
server binds that identity immutably before opening stdio. Codex and Claude use
distinct roots and namespaces by default. Missing configuration,
cross-namespace reuse, unsafe or malformed identity state, and silent adoption
of a populated legacy root fail closed. Intentional sharing requires both hosts
to configure the same root and namespace explicitly; repository paths remain
the only storage-adjacent input on normal navigation tools.

Normal context retrieval runs graph policy deterministically. The agent supplies
its query or known anchors; Loci chooses supported calls, types, references and
imports under fixed work and output budgets. Exact source paging hydrates selected
source. There is no per-request intent, family, direction, hop or enable-graph
choice. Native endpoints, complete selected proof, freshness and explicit unknowns
remain required. Source locators do not establish prior issuance or delivery.

Legacy primitive and opt-in traversal tools are an explicit operator diagnostic
surface; their exact-neighbour contract remains contains-only. Unresolved or
unsupported observations never become guessed trusted edges. Actual native
receipts now establish the repaired host's complete binding proof, browser and
renderer controls, exact source paging and byte accounting. The selection policy
gives direct selected-anchor relationships priority over incidental ownership
expansion without increasing budgets or weakening proof.

The selected next repair now prioritizes one representative supported input-type
path per selected callable before ordinary family interleaving. Explicit pairs
retain precedence; one shared neighborhood allowance and accepted proof/packing
transitions preserve budgets and controls. Structural input-role evidence
excludes generic constraints and body annotations. Unsupported multiline and
ambiguous nested roles remain ordinary edges.

Normal retrieval and reads now issue deterministic 30-character handles for
exact continuation. A bounded per-repository cache retains the full canonical
locator and survives process restart. Only final emitted references are persisted.
Unknown or evicted handles require fresh retrieval; legacy encoded locators
remain readable. Exact repository/hash/extent/UTF8 and source-containment checks
remain. Handles are not authorization credentials and still require exact reuse.
